body:
Status on the round-1 fix-now findings, per the author's triage (R-12 rated later; the remaining "later" items untouched). Pushed as `f4d19b9`.

| id | state | what landed |
|---|---|---|
| R-01 | fixed | The integration suite reads `DATABASE_URL_TEST` only; `DATABASE_URL` is never truncated. Proven: with `DATABASE_URL` set and `DATABASE_URL_TEST` unset the suite skips. README documents the variable as the throwaway connection. |
| R-06 | fixed | Comment and `docs/quality/testing.md` now describe the global threshold as the aggregate it is. `tests/unit/coverage-thresholds.test.ts` is the actual net: fails `check` when a top-level `src/` directory has no glob, a root module is unmeasured, or a glob sits below its layer's target. That last assertion also covers R-16. |
| R-07 | patch to author | The CI `test` job must pass the Neon branch as `DATABASE_URL_TEST` and fail closed without it. Workflow files cannot be pushed from this session; the patch is with the author. Until it lands, CI skips the integration suite and reports green while measuring less. |
| R-11 | fixed | `recaptcha-bridge.tsx` is measured and unit-tested with a stubbed `document` and `window.grecaptcha` (six cases). The false Playwright justification is gone from the config and the docs. |
| R-13 | fixed | `docs/quality/testing.md` has a threshold history recording the 2026-09-20 introduction, the 2026-09-22 post-merge lowering with its reason, and this round. |
| R-15 | fixed | `instrumentation.ts`, `instrumentation-client.ts`, both `sentry.*.config.ts` and `next.config.ts` are measured under their own glob at 100/100/100/100, with new tests for `instrumentation.ts`, the `next.config.ts` header rules, and `instrumentation-client.ts` failure paths. |

Ratchet: adding the bridge and the root modules changed what `src/features/**` measures; it re-measured at 90/90/86/88 and the floor moved up to that. `bun run check` (coverage included) exits 0: 582 tests, 98 files, 1 skipped.

body:
**`e2e` red on `f4d19b9`, not this PR's change.** One of 67 Playwright tests failed on both attempts: `tests/e2e/living-lexicon.spec.ts:28` (autoplay ping-pongs through the whole Lexicon while visible), where the mocked clock advanced but `aria-current` had not moved from `gloaming` to the next word.

Why it is not this PR's: `git diff a35ef79 f4d19b9` excluding tests, docs and `vitest.config.ts` is empty, so the deployed app under test is byte-identical to the previous head, on which the same spec passed. The same runtime code also passed E2E on `e4266c8` and `6a92729`. Nothing in this PR touches the Living Lexicon client, GSAP or the E2E harness.

No fix exists to port: the spec drives autoplay through `page.clock` and IntersectionObserver timing in Chromium under four workers, and this branch is not the place to redesign it. Re-running the failed job once now to confirm. If it fails again I will treat it as real and look at making the spec robust.
